kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-baseline-configs --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --owner 952795270000 --project-id 1234 --priority 1,3,5,7,8 --useflag true --baseline-types DAILY,HOURLY --search-text Baseline_name_search_keywords --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBaselineConfigs

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页的页数。默认值为1，最小值为1，最大值为30
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据行数。默认值为10，最小值为1，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the baseline owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. You can call the ListProjects operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的ID。您可以通过ListProjects接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The priority of the baseline. Valid values: {1,3,5,7,8}. Separate multiple priorities with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 基线的优先级，取值范围为{1,3,5,7,8} 。多个优先级之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the baseline. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启，包括true（开启）和false（未开启）
parameters.name: useflag

parameters.help_en: The type of the baseline. Valid values: DAILY and HOURLY. Separate multiple baseline types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 基线类型，包括DAILY（天基线）和HOURLY（小时基线）。多个类型之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: baseline_types

parameters.help_en: The keyword in the baseline name, which is used to search for the baseline
parameters.help_zh: 基线名称的搜索关键字
parameters.name: search_text
